lyrics.ja: まだほんのちょっと未練がましく
lyrics.romaji: Mada Honno Chotto Miren ga Mashiku
lyrics.en: Still just a little clingingly

lyrics.ja: キミが好きだった歌をかけてみる
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ga Suki Datta Uta wo Kakete Miru
lyrics.en: I try playing the song you used to love
lyrics.zh: 試著播放你曾喜歡的那首歌

lyrics.ja: 動かなくなった柱時計の針
lyrics.romaji: Ugokanaku Natta Hashira Dokei no Hari
lyrics.en: The hands of the wall clock that stopped moving

lyrics.ja: ただ空回った歯車がひとつ
lyrics.romaji: Tada Karamawatta Haguruma ga Hitotsu
lyrics.en: Just one gear spinning in vain

lyrics.ja: (Ah...Ah...)ストラトの(Ah...Ah...)泣き声が響いた
lyrics.romaji: (Ah...Ah...) Sutorato no (Ah...Ah...) Nakigoe ga Hibiita
lyrics.en: (Ah...Ah...) The Strat's (Ah...Ah...) crying voice resounded

lyrics.ja: 私の名前なんて忘れていいよ
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Namae Nante Wasurete Ii yo
lyrics.en: You can forget my name
lyrics.zh: 我的名字什麼的，忘掉也沒關係

lyrics.ja: ヒラリ　舞い散る花のように
lyrics.romaji: Hirari Mai Chiru Hana no You ni
lyrics.en: Like a flower fluttering down
lyrics.zh: 宛如輕飄飄散落的花瓣

lyrics.ja: だけどいつかこの歌を聴くときは
lyrics.romaji: Dakedo Itsuka Kono Uta wo Kiku Toki ha
lyrics.en: But someday, when you listen to this song
lyrics.zh: 但當有一天你聽見這首歌時

lyrics.ja: ねえ、隣に誰かがいたこと思い出して
lyrics.romaji: Nee, Tonari ni Dareka ga Ita Koto Omoidashite
lyrics.en: Hey, remember that someone was by your side
lyrics.zh: 吶，請想起曾有個人陪在你身旁

lyrics.ja: 「お幸せにね」って最後の言葉
lyrics.romaji: 「Oshiawase ni ne」 tte Saigo no Kotoba
lyrics.en: "Be happy" were my last words

lyrics.ja: 無理につよがって笑ってみたけど
lyrics.romaji: Muri ni Tsuyogatte Waratte Mita kedo
lyrics.en: I forced myself to act strong and smiled

lyrics.ja: 私と付き合っていたころよりも
lyrics.romaji: Watashi to Tsukiatte Ita Koro yori mo
lyrics.en: More than when you were with me
lyrics.zh: 比起和我交往的那段時光

lyrics.ja: 幸せになってほしくはないのよ
lyrics.romaji: Shiawase ni Natte Hoshiku ha Nai no yo
lyrics.en: I don't want you to be happier
lyrics.zh: 我不希望你變得更幸福啊

lyrics.ja: (Ah...Ah...)バスドラが(Ah...Ah...)心を蹴飛ばした
lyrics.romaji: (Ah...Ah...) Basudora ga (Ah...Ah...) Kokoro wo Ketobashita
lyrics.en: (Ah...Ah...) The bass drum (Ah...Ah...) kicked my heart

lyrics.ja: 初デートの写真もペアリングも
lyrics.romaji: Hatsu Deeto no Shashin mo Pea Ringu mo
lyrics.en: The photo from our first date, the pair rings
lyrics.zh: 初次約會的照片和對戒

lyrics.ja: 簡単に捨てられたのに
lyrics.romaji: Kantan ni Suterareta no ni
lyrics.en: Though they were easily thrown away

lyrics.ja: 胸に刻まれた歌声のせいで
lyrics.romaji: Mune ni Kizamareta Utagoe no Sei de
lyrics.en: Because of the singing voice etched in my heart

lyrics.ja: また、キミの笑顔思い出してしまうんだ
lyrics.romaji: Mata, Kimi no Egao Omoidashite Shimau n Da
lyrics.en: I end up remembering your smile again
lyrics.zh: 又不禁想起了你的笑容

lyrics.ja: 私の泣き声が響いた
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Nakigoe ga Hibiita
lyrics.en: My crying voice resounded

lyrics.ja: 鎖で繋ぎ止められたメロディー
lyrics.romaji: Kusari de Tsunagi Tomerareta Merodii
lyrics.en: A melody chained and held in place

lyrics.ja: もうサヨナラ告げるために
lyrics.romaji: Mou Sayonara Tsugeru Tame ni
lyrics.en: To say goodbye already

lyrics.ja: プレイリストから消去しようとして
lyrics.romaji: Pureirisuto kara Shoukyo Shiyou to Shite
lyrics.en: I try to delete it from the playlist
lyrics.zh: 試圖從播放清單中刪去

lyrics.ja: でも、それすらもできなくて
lyrics.romaji: Demo, Sore Sura mo Dekinakute
lyrics.en: But I can't even do that

lyrics.ja: どうせ忘れることはできないから
lyrics.romaji: Douse Wasureru Koto ha Dekinai kara
lyrics.en: Because I can't forget anyway

lyrics.ja: 未練がましく生きてゆく
lyrics.romaji: Miren ga Mashiku Ikite Yuku
lyrics.en: I'll keep living clingingly

lyrics.ja: せめて次にこの歌を聴くときは
lyrics.romaji: Semete Tsugi ni Kono Uta wo Kiku Toki ha
lyrics.en: At least the next time I listen to this song
lyrics.zh: 至少下次聽見這首歌時

lyrics.ja: ねえ、今よりも上手に笑えるように
lyrics.romaji: Nee, Ima yori mo Jouzu ni Waraeru You ni
lyrics.en: Hey, so that I can smile better than now
lyrics.zh: 吶，願我能比現在笑得更好

lyrics.ja: ねえ、最後まで涙を流さないように
lyrics.romaji: Nee, Saigo made Namida wo Nagasanai You ni
lyrics.en: Hey, so that I won't shed tears until the very end
lyrics.zh: 吶，願我能到最後都不流淚
